events.verdict: Hayes (LAL) firms up in a screening position in Williams' (CHI) path and does not deliver contact.
Hayes (LAL) moves laterally into White (CHI), initiating body contact that causes him to lose control of the ball during the driving shot attempt.
Giddey (CHI) pursues the loose ball and makes marginal contact with Hayes' (LAL) head during the rebound.
Huerter (CHI) does not bring his hand underneath the ball as he hesitates and resumes his dribble thereafter.
Vucevic (CHI) establishes himself in a screening position in Hayes' (LAL) path and collapses his arms against his own body before contact. The ensuing contact is not delivered by Vucevic.

On Giddey's (CHI) drive that originates outside the LDB, Reaves (LAL) is the secondary defender and does not establish himself in a legal guarding position outside of the restricted area prior to contact.
Vucevic (CHI) maintains a legal guarding position alongside of Reaves' (LAL) path to the basket.
Vucevic (CHI) commits a take foul on Reaves (LAL).
James (LAL) legally contests Williams' (CHI) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Williams (CHI) briefly engages with Reaves (LAL) before immediately sliding his hands off and allowing him to move freely.
Reaves (LAL) legally contests White's (CHI) jump shot attempt.
Reaves (LAL) briefly grasps Williams (CHI) with his off-arm, but the contact during the drive is marginal.
Giddey (CHI) legally takes two steps into his shooting motion.
James (LAL) legally contests Giddey's (CHI) jump shot attempt.
